speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: You have stayed at this mountain long enough.

speaker: god
text: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the foothills, in the Negev, and along the seacoast to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great River Euphrates.

speaker: god
text: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: I cannot carry the burden for you alone.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.

speaker: moses
text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.

speaker: moses
text: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?

speaker: moses
text: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: What you propose to do is good.

speaker: moses
text: Hear the disputes between your brothers, and judge fairly between a man and his brother or a foreign resident.

speaker: moses
text: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be intimidated by anyone, for judgment belongs to God. And bring to me any case too difficult for you, and I will hear it.

speaker: moses
text: You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.

speaker: moses
text: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

speaker: israelites
text: Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter.

speaker: twelve-spies
name: Twelve spies
text: It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us.

speaker: israelites
text: Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.

speaker: israelites
text: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying: ‘The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’

speaker: twelve-spies
text: The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.

speaker: moses
text: Do not be terrified or afraid of them!

speaker: moses
text: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt

speaker: moses
text: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.

speaker: god
text: Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers,

speaker: god
text: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.

speaker: god
text: Not even you shall enter the land.

speaker: god
text: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.

speaker: god
text: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.

speaker: god
text: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea.

speaker: israelites
text: We have sinned against the LORD,

speaker: israelites
text: We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God has commanded us.

speaker: god
text: Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: You have been wandering around this hill country long enough; turn to the north

speaker: god
text: and command the people: ‘You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.

speaker: god
text: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.

speaker: moses
text: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.

speaker: god
text: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’

speaker: moses
text: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.

speaker: god
text: Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.

speaker: god
text: Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.

speaker: god
text: Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.

speaker: god
text: But when you get close to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession.

speaker: god
text: Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

speaker: god
text: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven. They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you.

speaker: moses
text: Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.

speaker: moses
text: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot,

speaker: moses
text: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.

speaker: god
text: See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.

speaker: moses
text: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,

speaker: moses
text: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.

speaker: moses
text: Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.

speaker: moses
text: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you.

speaker: moses
text: O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?

speaker: moses
text: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!

speaker: god
text: That is enough,

speaker: god
text: Do not speak to Me again about this matter.

speaker: god
text: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.

speaker: god
text: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.

speaker: peoples
name: The peoples
text: Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

speaker: god
text: You shall have no other gods before Me.

speaker: god
text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.

speaker: god
text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,

speaker: god
text: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.

speaker: god
text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.

speaker: god
text: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

speaker: god
text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

speaker: god
text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.

speaker: god
text: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

speaker: god
text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.

speaker: god
text: You shall not murder.

speaker: god
text: You shall not commit adultery.

speaker: god
text: You shall not steal.

speaker: god
text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

speaker: god
text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

speaker: israelites
text: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.

speaker: israelites
text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?

speaker: israelites
text: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.

speaker: god
text: I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.

speaker: god
text: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.

speaker: god
text: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Return to your tents.

speaker: god
text: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.

speaker: unnamed-son
name: Unnamed son
text: What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

speaker: israelites
text: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.

speaker: israelites
text: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.

speaker: israelites
text: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.

speaker: israelites
text: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.

speaker: unnamed-people
name: Unnamed people
text: Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.

speaker: god
text: I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

speaker: god
text: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.

speaker: god
text: Go up and possess the land that I have given you.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

speaker: moses
text: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people and the wickedness of their sin.

speaker: moses
text: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

speaker: people-of-egypt
name: People of Egypt
text: Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.
tag: those in the land from which You brought us out

speaker: moses
text: But they are Your people, Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

speaker: god
text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.

speaker: god
text: Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: I want to eat meat,

speaker: israelites
text: How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.

speaker: unnamed-false-prophet
name: Unnamed false prophet or dreamer
text: Let us follow other gods (which you have not known) and let us worship them,

speaker: unnamed-enticer
name: Unnamed relative or friend
text: Let us go and worship other gods
tag: your very own brother, or your son or daughter, or the wife you embrace, or your closest friend

speaker: unnamed-wicked-men
name: Unnamed wicked men
text: Let us go and serve other gods

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: The seventh year, the year of release, is near,

speaker: unnamed-servant
name: Unnamed servant
text: I do not want to leave you,

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: You are never to go back that way again.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this great fire anymore, so that we will not die!

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: They have spoken well.

speaker: god
text: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

speaker: god
text: And I will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name.

speaker: god
text: But if any prophet dares to speak a message in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or to speak in the name of other gods, that prophet must be put to death.

speaker: israelites
text: How can we recognize a message that the LORD has not spoken?

speaker: unnamed-priest
name: Unnamed priest
text: Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle with your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be alarmed or terrified because of them.

speaker: unnamed-priest
text: For the LORD your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies, to give you the victory.

speaker: officers
name: Officers
text: Has any man built a new house and not dedicated it? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man dedicate it.

speaker: officers
text: Has any man planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy its fruit? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man enjoy its fruit.

speaker: officers
text: Has any man become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him return home, or he may die in battle and another man marry her.

speaker: officers
text: Is any man afraid or fainthearted? Let him return home, so that the hearts of his brothers will not melt like his own.

speaker: elders-of-city
name: Elders of the city
text: Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it.

speaker: elders-of-city
text: Accept this atonement, O LORD, for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them.

speaker: unnamed-parents
name: Unnamed father and mother
text: This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he does not obey us. He is a glutton and a drunkard.

speaker: unnamed-husband
name: Unnamed husband
text: I married this woman and had relations with her, but I discovered she was not a virgin.

speaker: unnamed-father-of-bride
name: Unnamed father of the young woman
text: I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he has come to hate her.

speaker: unnamed-father-of-bride
text: And now he has accused her of shameful conduct, saying, ‘I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin.’ But here is the proof of her virginity.

speaker: unnamed-husband
text: I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin.

speaker: unnamed-widow
name: Unnamed widow
text: My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.

speaker: unnamed-brother-in-law
name: Unnamed brother-in-law
text: I do not want to marry her,

speaker: unnamed-widow
text: This is what is done to the man who will not maintain his brother’s line.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: The House of the Unsandaled.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
name: Israelite worshiper
text: I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt few in number and lived there and became a great nation, mighty and numerous.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us, putting us to hard labor.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: So we called out to the LORD, the God of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror, signs, and wonders.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD, have given me.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me. I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while in mourning, or removed any of it while unclean, or offered any of it for the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything You commanded me.

speaker: israelite-worshiper
text: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.

speaker: moses-and-elders
name: Moses and the elders of Israel
text: Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.
tag: Moses and the elders of Israel

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: And when you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to coat them with plaster.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.

speaker: moses-and-elders
text: And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.

speaker: moses-and-levitical-priests
name: Moses and the Levitical priests
text: Be silent, O Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.

speaker: moses-and-levitical-priests
text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

speaker: moses
text: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

speaker: moses
text: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite:

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
name: Levites
text: Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who lies with any animal.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
text: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

speaker: levites
text: Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.

speaker: israelites
text: Amen!

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

speaker: moses
text: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:

speaker: moses
text: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

speaker: moses
text: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock— the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

speaker: moses
text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.

speaker: moses
text: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.

speaker: moses
text: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.

speaker: moses
text: Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from any of the words I command you today, and do not go after other gods to serve them.

speaker: moses
text: If, however, you do not obey the LORD your God by carefully following all His commandments and statutes I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:

speaker: moses
text: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

speaker: moses
text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be cursed.

speaker: moses
text: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, as well as the produce of your land, the calves of your herds, and the lambs of your flocks.

speaker: moses
text: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will send curses upon you, confusion and reproof in all to which you put your hand, until you are destroyed and quickly perish because of the wickedness you have committed in forsaking Him.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will make the plague cling to you until He has exterminated you from the land that you are entering to possess.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.

speaker: moses
text: The sky over your head will be bronze, and the earth beneath you iron.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will turn the rain of your land into dust and powder; it will descend on you from the sky until you are destroyed.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will march out against them in one direction but flee from them in seven. You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

speaker: moses
text: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt, with tumors and scabs and itch from which you cannot be cured.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,

speaker: moses
text: and at noon you will grope about like a blind man in the darkness. You will not prosper in your ways. Day after day you will be oppressed and plundered, with no one to save you.

speaker: moses
text: You will be pledged in marriage to a woman, but another man will violate her. You will build a house but will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard but will not enjoy its fruit.

speaker: moses
text: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.

speaker: moses
text: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, while your eyes grow weary looking for them day after day, with no power in your hand.

speaker: moses
text: A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.

speaker: moses
text: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will bring you and the king you appoint to a nation neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will worship other gods—gods of wood and stone.

speaker: moses
text: You will become an object of horror, scorn, and ridicule among all the nations to which the LORD will drive you.

speaker: moses
text: You will sow much seed in the field but harvest little, because the locusts will consume it.

speaker: moses
text: You will plant and cultivate vineyards, but will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

speaker: moses
text: You will have olive trees throughout your territory but will never anoint yourself with oil, because the olives will drop off.

speaker: moses
text: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not remain yours, because they will go into captivity.

speaker: moses
text: Swarms of locusts will consume all your trees and the produce of your land.

speaker: moses
text: The foreigner living among you will rise higher and higher above you, while you sink down lower and lower.

speaker: moses
text: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

speaker: moses
text: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.

speaker: moses
text: These curses will be a sign and a wonder upon you and your descendants forever.

speaker: moses
text: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,

speaker: moses
text: you will serve your enemies the LORD will send against you in famine, thirst, nakedness, and destitution. He will place an iron yoke on your neck until He has destroyed you.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will bring a nation from afar, from the ends of the earth, to swoop down upon you like an eagle—a nation whose language you will not understand,

speaker: moses
text: a ruthless nation with no respect for the old and no pity for the young.

speaker: moses
text: They will eat the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain or new wine or oil, no calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks, until they have caused you to perish.

speaker: moses
text: They will besiege all the cities throughout your land, until the high and fortified walls in which you trust have fallen. They will besiege all your cities throughout the land that the LORD your God has given you.

speaker: moses
text: Then you will eat the fruit of your womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you.

speaker: moses
text: The most gentle and refined man among you will begrudge his brother, the wife he embraces, and the rest of his children who have survived,

speaker: moses
text: refusing to share with any of them the flesh of his children he will eat because he has nothing left in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within all your gates.

speaker: moses
text: The most gentle and refined woman among you, so gentle and refined she would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground, will begrudge the husband she embraces and her son and daughter

speaker: moses
text: the afterbirth that comes from between her legs and the children she bears, because she will secretly eat them for lack of anything else in the siege and distress that your enemy will inflict on you within your gates.

speaker: moses
text: If you are not careful to observe all the words of this law which are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and awesome name—the LORD your God—

speaker: moses
text: He will bring upon you and your descendants extraordinary disasters, severe and lasting plagues, and terrible and chronic sicknesses.

speaker: moses
text: He will afflict you again with all the diseases you dreaded in Egypt, and they will cling to you.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will also bring upon you every sickness and plague not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.

speaker: moses
text: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.

speaker: moses
text: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and multiply, so also it will please Him to annihilate you and destroy you. And you will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.

speaker: moses
text: Then the LORD will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.

speaker: moses
text: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.

speaker: moses
text: So your life will hang in doubt before you, and you will be afraid night and day, never certain of survival.

speaker: moses
text: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: If only it were evening!

speaker: israelites
text: If only it were morning!

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will return you to Egypt in ships by a route that I said you should never see again. There you will sell yourselves to your enemies as male and female slaves, but no one will buy you.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: You have seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials, and to all his land.

speaker: moses
text: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, and those miraculous signs and wonders.

speaker: moses
text: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.

speaker: moses
text: For forty years I led you in the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.

speaker: moses
text: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

speaker: moses
text: When you reached this place, Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan came out against us in battle, but we defeated them.

speaker: moses
text: We took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

speaker: moses
text: So keep and follow the words of this covenant, that you may prosper in all you do.

speaker: moses
text: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God—you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,

speaker: moses
text: your children and wives, and the foreigners in your camps who cut your wood and draw your water—

speaker: moses
text: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,

speaker: moses
text: and so that He may establish you today as His people, and He may be your God as He promised you and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

speaker: moses
text: I am making this covenant and this oath not only with you,

speaker: moses
text: but also with those who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God, as well as with those who are not here today.

speaker: moses
text: For you yourselves know how we lived in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the nations on the way here.

speaker: moses
text: You saw the abominations and idols among them made of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

speaker: moses
text: Make sure there is no man or woman, clan or tribe among you today whose heart turns away from the LORD our God to go and worship the gods of those nations. Make sure there is no root among you that bears such poisonous and bitter fruit,

speaker: moses
text: because when such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.’ This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

speaker: unnamed-apostate
name: Unnamed stubborn person
text: I will have peace, even though I walk in the stubbornness of my own heart.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will never be willing to forgive him. Instead, His anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and every curse written in this book will fall upon him. The LORD will blot out his name from under heaven

speaker: moses
text: and single him out from all the tribes of Israel for disaster, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

speaker: moses
text: Then the generation to come—your sons who follow you and the foreigner who comes from a distant land—will see the plagues of the land and the sicknesses the LORD has inflicted on it.

speaker: moses
text: All its soil will be a burning waste of sulfur and salt, unsown and unproductive, with no plant growing on it, just like the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His fierce anger.

speaker: moses
text: So all the nations will ask, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?’

speaker: nations
name: All the nations
text: Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land? Why this great outburst of anger?

speaker: moses
text: And the people will answer, ‘It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.

speaker: unnamed-people
name: The people
text: It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.

speaker: moses
text: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known—gods that the LORD had not given to them.

speaker: unnamed-people
text: They went and served other gods, and they worshiped gods they had not known—gods that the LORD had not given to them.

speaker: moses
text: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against this land, and He brought upon it every curse written in this book.

speaker: unnamed-people
text: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against this land, and He brought upon it every curse written in this book.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.’

speaker: unnamed-people
text: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.

speaker: moses
text: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: When all these things come upon you—the blessings and curses I have set before you—and you call them to mind in all the nations to which the LORD your God has banished you,

speaker: moses
text: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey His voice with all your heart and all your soul according to everything I am giving you today,

speaker: moses
text: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.

speaker: moses
text: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.

speaker: moses
text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

speaker: moses
text: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.

speaker: moses
text: And you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all His commandments I am giving you today.

speaker: moses
text: So the LORD your God will make you abound in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land. Indeed, the LORD will again delight in your goodness, as He delighted in that of your fathers,

speaker: moses
text: if you obey the LORD your God by keeping His commandments and statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, and if you turn to Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

speaker: moses
text: For this commandment I give you today is not too difficult for you or beyond your reach.

speaker: moses
text: It is not in heaven, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Who will ascend into heaven to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?

speaker: moses
text: And it is not beyond the sea, that you should need to ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?’

speaker: israelites
text: Who will cross the sea to get it for us and proclaim it, that we may obey it?

speaker: moses
text: But the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may obey it.

speaker: moses
text: See, I have set before you today life and goodness, as well as death and disaster.

speaker: moses
text: For I am commanding you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in His ways, and to keep His commandments, statutes, and ordinances, so that you may live and increase, and the LORD your God may bless you in the land that you are entering to possess.

speaker: moses
text: But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, but are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

speaker: moses
text: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

speaker: moses
text: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,

speaker: moses
text: and that you may love the LORD your God, obey Him, and hold fast to Him. For He is your life, and He will prolong your life in the land that the LORD swore to give to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to come and go, and the LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not cross the Jordan.’

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: You shall not cross the Jordan.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD your God Himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will dispossess them. Joshua will cross ahead of you, as the LORD has said.

speaker: moses
text: And the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, when He destroyed them along with their land.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD will deliver them over to you, and you must do to them exactly as I have commanded you.

speaker: moses
text: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.

speaker: moses
text: Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their fathers to give them, and you shall give it to them as an inheritance.

speaker: moses
text: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

speaker: moses
text: At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of remission of debt, during the Feast of Tabernacles,

speaker: moses
text: when all Israel comes before the LORD your God at the place He will choose, you are to read this law in the hearing of all Israel.

speaker: moses
text: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.

speaker: moses
text: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

speaker: god
text: Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.

speaker: god
text: You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.

speaker: god
text: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’

speaker: israelites
name: Israelites
text: Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?

speaker: god
text: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.

speaker: god
text: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.

speaker: god
text: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.

speaker: god
text: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.

speaker: god
text: Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.

speaker: moses
text: Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.

speaker: moses
text: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!

speaker: moses
text: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

speaker: moses
text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.

speaker: god
text: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.

speaker: god
text: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.

speaker: god
text: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.

speaker: god
text: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.

speaker: god
text: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.

speaker: god
text: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,

speaker: god
text: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’

speaker: enemies-of-israel
name: Adversaries of Israel
text: Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.

speaker: god
text: Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?

speaker: god
text: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.

speaker: god
text: Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

speaker: god
text: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!

speaker: god
text: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.

speaker: god
text: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,

speaker: god
text: when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.

speaker: god
text: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh— the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Take to heart all these words I testify among you today, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.

speaker: moses
text: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

speaker: god
text: Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.

speaker: god
text: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

speaker: god
text: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.

speaker: god
text: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.

speaker: moses
text: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—

speaker: moses
text: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

speaker: moses
text: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.

speaker: moses
text: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.

speaker: moses
text: O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.

speaker: moses
text: Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.

speaker: moses
text: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.

speaker: levi
name: Levi
text: I do not consider them.

speaker: moses
text: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.

speaker: moses
text: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.

speaker: moses
text: May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.

speaker: moses
text: May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above and the deep waters that lie beneath,

speaker: moses
text: with the bountiful harvest from the sun and the abundant yield of the seasons,

speaker: moses
text: with the best of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills,

speaker: moses
text: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.

speaker: moses
text: His majesty is like a firstborn bull, and his horns are like those of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even to the ends of the earth. Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh.

speaker: moses
text: Rejoice, Zebulun, in your journeys, and Issachar, in your tents.

speaker: moses
text: They will call the peoples to a mountain; there they will offer sacrifices of righteousness. For they will feast on the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand.

speaker: moses
text: Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.

speaker: moses
text: He chose the best land for himself, because a ruler’s portion was reserved for him there. He came with the leaders of the people; he administered the LORD’s justice and His ordinances for Israel.

speaker: moses
text: Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.

speaker: moses
text: Naphtali is abounding with favor, full of the blessing of the LORD; he shall take possession of the sea and the south.

speaker: moses
text: May Asher be the most blessed of sons; may he be the most favored among his brothers and dip his foot in oil.

speaker: moses
text: May the bolts of your gate be iron and bronze, and may your strength match your days.

speaker: moses
text: There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.

speaker: moses
text: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: Destroy him!

speaker: moses
text: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.

speaker: moses
text: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is the shield that protects you, the sword in which you boast. Your enemies will cower before you, and you shall trample their high places.

speaker: god
name: The LORD (God)
text: This is the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.

speaker: god
text: I will give it to your descendants.
